definitions.gloss: celebratory toast; victory drink; celebratory cup
definitions.explanation: A drink raised in celebration of an achievement, victory, or happy occasion. The act of drinking to celebrate.

examples.japanese: {祝杯|しゅくはい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{挙|あ}げる→挙げる：27889_ageru⟧。
examples.english: To raise a toast in celebration.

examples.japanese: ⟦{優勝|ゆうしょう}→優勝：03647_yuushou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{祝杯|しゅくはい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{挙|あ}げた→挙げる：27889_ageru⟧。
examples.english: We raised a toast to the championship victory.

examples.japanese: ⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{努力|どりょく}→努力：03490_doryoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{実|みの}り→実る：00282_minoru⟧、⟦チーム→チーム：03858_chiimu⟧⟦{全員|ぜんいん}→全員：03310_zenin⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{祝杯|しゅくはい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{挙|あ}げて→挙げる：27889_ageru⟧⟦{喜|よろこ}び→喜び：03672_yorokobi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{分|わ}かち{合|あ}った→分かち合う：18203_wakachiau⟧。
examples.english: Years of effort paid off, and the whole team raised a toast and shared in the joy.

notes:
USAGE:
Almost always appears in the set expression {祝杯|しゅくはい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{挙|あ}げる→挙げる：27889_ageru⟧ (to raise a celebratory toast). A somewhat formal and literary word.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {祝杯|しゅくはい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{挙|あ}げる→挙げる：27889_ageru⟧ (to raise a celebratory toast)
- ⟦{優勝|ゆうしょう}→優勝：03647_yuushou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{祝杯|しゅくはい} (a victory toast)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{献杯|けんぱい}→献杯：16799_kenpai⟧: a toast offered to the deceased — used at funerals and memorial services
- ⟦{乾杯|かんぱい}→乾杯：00176_kanpai⟧: cheers, toast — general, can be used at any occasion
